tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The warm off-white behind the logo in light; the near-black behind the reversed logo in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies and form fields sitting on ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: table headers, code blocks, input wells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card borders. Aqvessa separates with lines, not shadows. Decorative; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines. Sampled from the logo's wordmark; in dark, the off-white of the reversed logo. 16:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, table metadata. Sampled from the logo's TECHNOLOGIES line. 5.4:1 on ground in light, 8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The orange of the logo's A. Fills only: primary buttons, identity blocks, chart marks. White text on it is 4.6:1 in light. As text on ground it fails 4.5:1 in light, so use brand-text for links.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Orange used as text or a thin line: links, active tab labels, small icons. 5:1 on ground and 5.4:1 on surface in light.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill. 4.6:1 in light, 6.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for brand fills and links. White text on it is 7:1 in light.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, soft highlights, quiet identity blocks. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: signal-success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, paid, healthy. Always paired with a text label or icon.

tokens.name: signal-warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, pending, expiring. Always paired with a text label or icon. Do not use brand orange for warnings.

tokens.name: signal-danger
tokens.usage: Failed, overdue, destructive. Always paired with a text label or icon. Sits near brand orange in hue, so never show it as a bare colour.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: a hero statement or a cover title. Tight tracking echoes the logo wordmark. Sentence case.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on marketing pages and proposals.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Page titles in documents and product screens.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and introductions. Keep lines near 65 characters.
styles.sample: Aqvessa builds software and runs commerce for businesses that need systems they can rely on.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text and form fields.
styles.sample: Each invoice is issued in naira, with the USD equivalent shown where it applies.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and field labels. Set in capitals, never longer than four words.

styles.name: descriptor
styles.usage: The widely spaced capitals under the wordmark. One per page, directly under a heading or logo, never in running text.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Reference numbers, amounts in tables, code and API paths. Use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Related controls, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact padding in table cells and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding inside panels. The pitch of the ring pattern's half-step.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections on tablet.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections on desktop. The pitch of the ring pattern on covers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Identity blocks, tags and chips. The house corner, matching the logo's straight-cut A.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and large panels. The largest radius in the system.
